chunks.text:
[Intro]
{the light catches: a rising harp glissando and bell shimmer bloom out of a held note, a timpani swell and crash, and the lead rings out the first notes of the theme high and bright}
positive_styles: soaring warm pulse-wave lead singing the main theme in full
lush warm string chords and swelling pad
big joyful drums with crash cymbals

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the main melody whole in radiant A major, a rising lift then a warm settle home, soaring over harp arpeggios and full strings}
positive_styles: soaring warm pulse-wave lead singing the main theme in full
lush warm string chords and swelling pad
big joyful drums with crash cymbals

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the same melody with the second lead harmonising in thirds and bells sparkling, the arrangement fuller and higher}
positive_styles: soaring warm pulse-wave lead singing the main theme in full
lush warm string chords and swelling pad
big joyful drums with crash cymbals

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: tender and grateful, a turn through F sharp minor and D major, drums drop to soft brushes, strings remember the long night, then swell back toward home}
positive_styles: soaring warm pulse-wave lead singing the main theme in full
lush warm string chords and swelling pad
big joyful drums with crash cymbals

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the melody returns in full triumph with crash cymbals; the last bar lifts on E straight back into the main theme, no ending}
